Client Success Manager 
 Location: Remote, Canada (preferred) or United States
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor
 Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM (Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time)
 Base Compensation: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year
 Target OTE: Approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience
 Performance Incentives: Mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials
 About the Company 
 Our client is a done-for-you Meta advertising and appointment-setting agency. It supports medspas and aesthetic wellness businesses across the United States. As its client portfolio grows, the agency is hiring a dedicated Client Success Manager to build a consistent, proactive experience for clients after the sale.
 The Opportunity 
 You’ll own the experience of about 40 agency clients. That covers onboarding, campaign launch, ongoing service, retention, and renewal support. You’ll be clients’ main point of contact and the bridge between them and the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, sales, and operations teams.
 This is a client relationship and coordination role. It is not a hands-on media buying position. You’ll also help shape the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function, including the processes and playbook the team will rely on as it scales.
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead structured client onboarding, coordinate handoffs from sales to delivery, set expectations, and document client goals and success metrics.
 Manage a portfolio of about 40 client relationships through scheduled check-ins.
 Respond to client Slack messages within 24 hours on business days.
 Keep CRM records accurate and up to date.
 Spot dissatisfaction and at-risk accounts early, coordinate recovery plans, and support renewals and retention.
 Turn client concerns into clear actions for the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, and operations teams, and follow through until they’re resolved.
 Prepare client-facing performance updates and maintain a portfolio health dashboard that leadership can see.
 Improve onboarding checklists and SOPs, and build a repeatable Client Success playbook.
 Track retention, NPS trends, response times, and onboarding SLAs.
 What Success Looks Like 
 Annual client retention of 93% or higher.
 Every new-client onboarding completed within agreed SLAs.
 Every client contacted according to the established check-in schedule.
 Client interactions logged in the CRM within 24 hours, and churn risks identified before they escalate.
 Your First 90 Days 
 Days 1–30: Learn the client journey, tools, account history, and existing team workflows.
 Days 31–60: Begin managing about 10–20 accounts on your own, set up regular check-ins, and track account health.
 Days 61–90: Work toward full portfolio ownership, report on retention health, and recommend process improvements.
 Earning Potential 
 Base: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year.
 Variable: Performance incentives are mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials. Detailed retention bonus tiers will be shared before the offer stage.
 Target OTE: The total target earning opportunity is approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience. Earnings above base depend on performance and are not guaranteed.
 What We’re Looking For 
 About 1–2 years of relevant experience in client success, account management, customer service, or a client-facing agency role. Exceptional transferable experience will also be considered.
 Excellent spoken and written English, with confident client communication.
 Empathy, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.
 Strong organization and follow-through while managing multiple accounts and competing priorities.
 Proactive problem-solving and comfort working with distributed teams in a fast-moving environment.
 Ability to understand basic marketing performance reports and explain practical next steps to clients.
 Based in Canada (preferred) or the United States.
 Available Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with medspas, aesthetics, or wellness, or experience supporting growth at a medspa.
 Familiarity with GoHighLevel, ClickUp or similar project management tools, and Meta Ads Manager. These platforms can be taught.
 Fully remote role for candidates in Canada or the United States.
 Consistent Monday–Friday daytime schedule.
 Competitive USD base compensation of $60,000–$70,000 per year.
 Performance incentives tied to quarterly client retention, plus bonuses for client testimonials. Target OTE is approximately USD $80,000–$90,000.
 Training on the agency’s platforms, including GoHighLevel, ClickUp, and Meta Ads Manager.
 Chance to help build the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function and shape its processes and playbook.
 Room to grow as the agency scales, with potential paths to Senior Client Success Manager and Head of Client Success.

About WPP Media 
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 
 WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
 For more information, visit wppmedia.com .
 Position: Associate (Buyer), Direct Activation ( 12-Month Contract) 
 About WPP Media 
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
 At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:
 Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
 Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
 Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.
 Role OVERVIEW: 
 WPP Media is looking for a detail-oriented, analytical and collaborative media professional with 1–2 years of relevant media buying or activation experience to join our Direct Activation team.
 As an Associate (Buyer), Direct Activation , you will translate clients’ media strategies into effective investments and take day-to-day ownership of assigned buys. Building on your existing experience, you will contribute across the full media investment lifecycle — from marketplace analysis and negotiations through campaign activation, optimization, measurement and financial reconciliation — with guidance from senior team members on complex decisions and approvals.
 This is a cross-functional media investment role spanning offline and online channels, including Broadcast, Digital Display/Video, CTV/OLV, OOH/Print and other emerging media platforms. You will work directly with some of the world's largest media companies and technology platforms, manage day-to-day partner communications and apply your channel knowledge to evaluate opportunities and deliver against client objectives.
 We are looking for someone who brings a solid foundation in campaign execution, confidence working with budgets and performance data, and the judgement to resolve routine issues independently while escalating risks promptly. You should be ready to manage competing priorities, make informed recommendations and take accountability for the accuracy and delivery of your assigned investments while continuing to deepen your buying expertise.
 HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT 
 Develop media buying recommendations for assigned campaigns by analyzing marketplace intelligence, requesting proposals and comparing opportunities against audience, pricing and performance objectives.
 Evaluate media partners’ offerings, audiences, pricing and capabilities, and negotiate rates, added value and terms for assigned buys within approved parameters, with senior support as needed.
 Contribute actively to vendor meetings and industry discussions, sharing relevant marketplace updates and identifying opportunities for client campaigns.
 Translate approved media strategies into accurate, effective media buys, ensuring schedules, budgets, rates and deliverables align with agreed objectives and approvals.
 Own campaign activation and stewardship 
 Own day-to-day execution of assigned media investments, including accurate buy entry, insertion orders, trafficking coordination and documentation of approved changes.
 Coordinate with Planning, Ad Operations and media partners to confirm requirements, track launch readiness and resolve routine setup issues so campaigns launch accurately and on time.
 Monitor campaign pacing and delivery against commitments, investigate discrepancies and coordinate corrective action with partners, escalating material performance or budget risks promptly.
 Recommend campaign optimizations based on delivery and performance data and implement approved changes to keep investments aligned with client objectives.
 Use data to make better decisions 
 Validate campaign setup, budgets and measurement requirements before launch, identifying and resolving discrepancies with the appropriate teams.
 Prepare post-campaign analyses for assigned buys, assessing delivery and performance against objectives and translating findings into actionable recommendations for future investments.
 Maintain and reconcile client budgets and investment trackers, investigate invoice discrepancies with Finance and media partners, and follow through on outstanding items to support timely financial reconciliation.
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 In this role, success means taking dependable day-to-day ownership of assigned buys, with appropriate senior oversight, and consistently delivering on the following:
 Manage assigned campaigns accurately, efficiently and on time, meeting approved budgets and delivery commitments.
 Follow through from buying and activation to reporting and reconciliation, resolving routine issues independently and escalating material risks with proposed solutions.
 Build strong relationships with vendors and internal partners.
 Apply knowledge across traditional, digital and emerging media to strengthen buying recommendations and campaign outcomes.
 Demonstrate increasing independence, seek feedback and identify practical improvements to campaign workflows and reporting.
 WHAT YOU BRING 
 1–2 years of relevant experience in media buying, investment or activation, with hands-on responsibility for campaign execution and stewardship.
 Working knowledge of offline and digital direct media, including familiarity with broadcast, digital video and CTV/OLV buying principles and a desire to deepen cross-channel expertise.
 Strong numerical and analytical skills, with experience managing budgets, interpreting campaign data and using Excel to maintain trackers, analyze delivery and support reconciliation.
 Hands-on familiarity with media buying and reporting systems, buy-entry, insertion orders and trafficking workflows, plus experience evaluating proposals and supporting vendor negotiations.
 College or University education is an asset
 Exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
 Excellent time-management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and deadlines.
 A proactive, solutions-oriented approach, with the ability to investigate issues, interpret findings and make clear, evidence-based recommendations.
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change.
 Sound judgement to manage routine buying and campaign decisions within approved parameters, recognize when guidance is needed and escalate issues early.
 Collaborative, inclusive and respectful of different perspectives.
 Confident communicating with both internal stakeholders and external media partners. 
 Life at WPP Media & Benefits 
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 
 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
 Please read our Privacy Notice ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
 While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 
 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Position Overview
 The objective of this assignment is to ensure the successful production and delivery of high-quality Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs) from a strategic supplier. The selected consultant will work onsite at the supplier's manufacturing facility to monitor production activities, oversee quality compliance, identify manufacturing risks, and coordinate with supplier and customer stakeholders to ensure products are delivered on time and meet all technical and quality requirements.
 Key Responsibilities
 Production Surveillance 
 Monitor production planning and execution against agreed schedules and priorities.
 Track manufacturing progress and identify production constraints, material shortages, and capacity risks.
 Follow up on recovery plans and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions.
 Escalate issues that could impact production schedules or customer deliveries.
 Quality Surveillance 
 Monitor incoming, in-process, and final inspection activities.
 Verify compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, approved manufacturing processes, and quality standards.
 Ensure effective management of non-conforming products, rework activities, and corrective actions.
 Monitor containment actions and verify implementation of permanent corrective actions.
 Supplier Performance Management 
 Conduct regular operational reviews with supplier management.
 Monitor supplier production, delivery, and quality performance.
 Identify operational risks and drive mitigation plans.
 Coordinate with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to resolve technical and operational issues.
 Reporting & Communication 
 Prepare weekly status reports covering production progress, delivery performance, quality concerns, risks, and action plans.
 Maintain an open action tracker and quality issue log.
 Immediately communicate any issue that could impact product quality, production continuity, or delivery commitments.
 Provide recommendations to improve supplier manufacturing performance and establish sustainable process control.
 Required Qualifications 
 Minimum 5 years of experience in PCB/PCBA manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related electronics manufacturing environment.
 Strong understanding of PCB/PCBA manufacturing processes and electronics production.
 Experience in supplier development, supplier quality engineering, manufacturing surveillance, or industrial performance improvement.
 Working knowledge of IPC standards and AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems .
 Experience using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why Analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Fishbone, etc. 
 Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 Ability to work independently at the supplier's manufacturing facility while effectively collaborating with supplier leadership and customer teams.
 Deliverables
 The consultant will be expected to provide:
 Weekly production and quality status reports.
 Open action tracker.
 Risk assessment and recovery plan follow-up.
 Quality issue log.
 Recommendations for continuous improvement of supplier manufacturing and quality performance.
 Success Criteria
 The engagement will be considered successful based on:
 Stable production execution aligned with agreed schedules.
 On-time delivery of required quantities.
 Delivery of PCBAs meeting all technical, manufacturing, and quality requirements.
 Effective management and timely closure of production and quality issues.
 Sustainable improvements in supplier manufacturing performance and process control.
 If you have qualified candidates with relevant PCB/PCBA manufacturing and supplier quality experience who are available to start immediately, please share their updated resumes along with the following details:
 Total Experience
 Relevant PCB/PCBA Manufacturing Experience
 Supplier Quality/Manufacturing Surveillance Experience
 Experience with IPC, AS9100, and/or ISO 9001

Intermediate Hydrogeologist | P.Eng / P.Geo / EIT / GIT
 We are seeking an Intermediate Hydrogeologist to join our growing Hydrogeology team. This role will span hydrogeological investigations, groundwater monitoring, data analysis, and technical assessments. You’ll work alongside experienced hydrogeologists and multidisciplinary teams, applying your field and consulting expertise to address complex groundwater challenges and deliver practical solutions for our clients. The role will involve regular travel to U.S. and Canadian project sites
 Why Join Equilibrium? 
 Global reach. Specialist expertise. Real influence. 
 Equilibrium brings together the global reach and expertise of an established consultancy with the autonomy and agility of a specialist firm.
 Here, you’ll work closely with experienced leaders, have a genuine voice in the business and see the impact of your work firsthand. As we grow, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, deepen your expertise in geotechnical engineering and mine waste, and play a meaningful role in shaping what comes next.
 We want our people to grow with the business, build meaningful relationships and make a lasting contribution - not simply be part of the team, but help build the future of Equilibrium.
 The Role: 
 As an Intermediate Hydrogeologist , you’ll plan and deliver hydrogeological investigations, coordinate field programs, analyze and interpret groundwater data, and develop conceptual hydrogeological models to support engineering, mining, and natural resource projects. You’ll take increasing ownership of technical deliverables and project coordination, working closely with clients, project managers, and multidisciplinary teams while providing guidance to junior staff and contributing to high-quality project delivery.
 You will:
 Plan & Deliver Projects: Plan and coordinate hydrogeological investigations, groundwater monitoring programs, and assigned project scopes, managing schedules, budgets, resources, and technical requirements in collaboration with accounting staff, project managers and senior hydrogeological engineers.
 Lead Field Investigations: Conduct and coordinate groundwater and surface water sampling, drilling, well installation and development, lithological logging, groundwater level monitoring, and hydraulic testing, including packer testing. Oversee the use and maintenance of field equipment, troubleshoot issues, and ensure field procedures are developed and followed to meet project requirements.
 Analyze & Interpret Data: Compile, validate, manage, and interpret hydrogeological, geological, geochemical, climatological, and environmental data. Analyze hydraulic testing results and develop hydrographs, groundwater flow maps, and hydraulic gradient calculations to assess groundwater conditions and support technical recommendations.
 Develop Hydrogeological Assessments: Develop and refine conceptual hydrogeological models, identify data gaps and uncertainties, assess risks, and provide recommendations to support mine water management, engineering design, and further investigations.
 Technical Reporting & Quality Assurance: Prepare and review technical reports, work plans, proposals, data summaries, and field documentation. Apply QA/QC procedures, verify data accuracy and completeness, and resolve routine to moderately complex technical issues.
 Manage Client & Project Relationships: Communicate technical findings, field observations, project progress, and recommendations to clients and multidisciplinary teams. Coordinate project activities, provide timely updates, and support effective client service and delivery.
 Mentor & Develop Others: Provide technical guidance to junior staff, share technical knowledge, and promote consistent field practices, analytical skills, and professional development.
 Support Business Development: Contribute to proposals, scopes of work, investigation methodologies, and resource planning while strengthening client relationships and supporting continuous improvement of technical practices.
 Champion Health & Safety: Identify and manage health, safety, and environmental risks, contribute to safe work planning, comply with applicable legislation and site requirements, and promptly report hazards, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 Typically, 4 to 8 years of relevant consulting or industry experience in hydrogeology, mine dewatering or a related field.
 Demonstrated experience planning and executing hydrogeological investigations, groundwater monitoring, drilling, well installation and development, sampling, and hydraulic testing.
 Experience analyzing and interpreting hydrogeological data, aquifer testing, and developing conceptual hydrogeological models.
 Experience preparing and reviewing technical reports, presentations, work plans, proposals, and other consulting deliverables.
 Proficiency with Excel, GIS, Leapfrog, and hydrogeological databases; experience with Access or SQL is an asset.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical judgment skills 
 The ability to work independently and take ownership of technical work.
 Demonstrated ability to coordinate project and field activities, collaborate with clients and multidisciplinary teams, and provide guidance to junior team members.
 Experience in the mining sector and bilingual (English/French) communication ability are assets.
 Education & Certifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, Geological or Environmental Engineering, or a related field. 
 Master’s degree in hydrogeology is an asset. 
 Professional registration or eligibility for registration (e.g., P.Eng, P.Geo, EIT, GIT).
 About Equilibrium: 
 Complex challenges. Practical solutions. Technical excellence. 
 Equilibrium is a specialist technical consultancy serving the global mining and natural resources sectors. We bring together expertise in geotechnical engineering, structural geology, and hydrogeology, to solve complex technical challenges and deliver practical solutions for our clients.
 Founded by internationally respected technical leaders, we combine deep technical expertise with a practical, solutions-focused approach and close client relationships. Our multidisciplinary teams work across regions and disciplines to deliver work that is technically sound, practical and fit for purpose.
 Technical excellence is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to continuously improving our expertise, how we work and the value we deliver to our clients.
 Our People & Culture: 
 Different perspectives make us stronger. 
 We believe bringing together different experiences and ways of thinking makes our teams stronger and our work better. More than half of our team are women, reflecting the inclusive and collaborative culture we are building at Equilibrium.
 We look for people who are technically excellent, curious, empathetic and generous with their knowledge. Initiative, collaboration and fresh thinking shape how we work, while respect and transparency guide how we work with one another.
 We want people to feel heard, supported and empowered to contribute — whether that's sharing an idea, challenging an assumption or helping a colleague succeed.
 Our values — excellence, transparency, diversity and mindfulness of our impact — guide how we work with each other, serve our clients and contribute to our communities and the planet. 
 Compensation: 
 This position is suitable for candidates with varying levels of intermediate experience. The final compensation package will be determined based on the successful candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and overall fit for the role.
 Canada $100,000 - $125,000  CAD per year + Benefits + Bonus
 USA $90,000 - $114,000  USD per year + Benefits + Bonus
 Location: 
 Equilibrium operates globally, with offices in South Brisbane, Australia; Vancouver, Canada; and Portland and Phoenix, USA. 
 We welcome applications from qualified candidates based in Canada and the United States, with a preference for candidates located near our offices in Vancouver, southern Ontario (future office location), Portland, or Phoenix. Flexible hybrid and remote working arrangements may be considered, depending on location and project requirements. 
 Although the role may be based in either country, the initial assignment will be on a U.S.-based project and will require frequent travel to U.S. project sites. Candidates must be able to meet the applicable work authorization, entry, and travel requirements for their country of residence and project assignment. 
 Additional Requirements: 
 Work authorization: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where they will be employed. Candidates based in Canada must also be eligible to travel to the United States regularly for business and project assignments. Candidates based in the United States must also be eligible to travel to Canada regularly for business and project assignments.
 Travel: Frequent cross-border travel is required, potentially including extended field assignments and periods away from home. Candidates must maintain the documentation and status required for their applicable travel arrangements.
 Driver’s license: A valid driver's license is required for project-related travel, where applicable.
 Work schedules: Flexibility may be required to support field assignments, project demands, and collaboration across time zones.
 Screening: Depending on client and project requirements, successful candidates may need to complete security screening, background or criminal record checks, drug and alcohol testing, or other required verification processes.

 Oversee daily inbound operations, ensuring accurate and timely receipt, unloading, inspection, and system processing of inbound shipments in accordance with HP quality and inventory standards.

 Lead and support process improvement initiatives focused on optimizing receiving, putaway, inventory accuracy, dock throughput, and inbound cycle times.

This position designs, builds, and maintains Power BI reports and data models, writes and tunes the SQL beneath them, and maintains the Crystal Reports used for operational and printed reporting. Working alongside two full stack developers - one on the front end used by the shop floor, one on the back end and administrative side - and a project coordinator, this position complements in-house web and software development with the business intelligence layer that sits above it, and provides reporting, communication, and design support to the project as a whole. This position is based at Tayco's Etobicoke facility.
 Posting notice:  This posting is for 1 existing vacancy for a 12-month contract position.
 Your Responsibilities: 
 Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, datasets, and data
 models for management and senior management, including scheduled refreshes,
 gateway configuration, and workspace access.
 Write, review, and tune the SQL beneath all reporting, including queries, views, and
 stored procedures against the ERP and in-house application databases.
 Develop and maintain Crystal Reports for operational and printed reporting and support the users who depend on them.
 Translate requests from management into defined reporting requirements, the definitions, and the level of detail required - and confirm those definitions before building.
 Apply consistent visual design to reports and dashboards so that the intended audience can read them immediately, including layout, visual hierarchy, and appropriate selection of charts and tables.
 Administer and maintain reporting infrastructure on Windows Server, including scheduled jobs, permissions, service accounts, file shares, and report distribution.
 Contribute light front-end work to the in-house web applications alongside the development team, including HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap changes and the embedding of reports and dashboards into application pages.
 Prepare presentation and communication materials for management and senior management, including slide decks, one-page summaries, and status reporting on the project.
 Use Git and GitHub for version control of report definitions, SQL, and related code, following the team's branching and review practices.
 Verify reported figures against source systems and investigate and resolve discrepancies before they reach a decision-maker.
 Document data sources, report definitions, measures, and reporting processes, and keep that documentation current.
 Provide training and support to report to consumers throughout the organization.
 Use AI-assisted tools with sound judgement, reviewing what is generated, selecting which problems to delegate, and remaining accountable for every query, measure, and figure delivered.
 Perform various analysis and reporting tasks as required.
 Must have post-secondary education in business intelligence, computer science, information systems, statistics, or a related field, or 3-5 years of industry experience in a business intelligence or data analysis role.
 Must have demonstrated proficiency with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX measures, Power Query, report design, and the management of publishing and scheduled refreshes.
 Must have strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregation, window functions, views, and query performance tuning against relational databases.
 Experience developing and maintaining Crystal Reports is required.
 Working knowledge of Windows Server administration as it relates to reporting: scheduled tasks, permissions, service accounts, file shares, and report distribution.
 Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap, sufficient to make small and safe changes to existing web application pages and to embed reports into them.
 Must be able to use Git and GitHub for version control, including branching, pull requests, and code review.

Cyclic Materials is building a resilient circular supply chain for rare earth elements and other critical materials. Through our fully integrated proprietary technology platform, we recover rare earths from end-of-life products and transform them into high-purity materials used to produce new permanent magnets. These magnets are critical to the modern economy, underpinning AI, automotive, e-mobility, electronics, semiconductor, energy, defense, and other advanced manufacturing sectors.
Founded in 2021, Cyclic Materials has rapidly become a category leader in rare earth recovery, achieving commercial operations in less than five years. We currently operate facilities in Ontario and Arizona, with further expansion underway in South Carolina. Backed by investment accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., alongside strategic investors including Microsoft, Amazon, Hitachi Ventures, BMW i Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion fund, Energy Impact Partners, ArcTern Ventures, and Fifth Wall, we are scaling quickly and building the industrial backbone required to meet growing global demand for a secure and sustainable supply of rare earths.
We have established an extensive and growing network of commercial partnerships with global industry leaders such as Solvay, Vattenfall, Lime, and VACUUMSCHMELZE, enabling the rapid deployment of recycled rare earth materials into real-world supply chains. Joining Cyclic Materials means tackling complex and exciting challenges at scale alongside a team committed to strong execution and measurable impact. If you are motivated by building critical infrastructure and advancing the circular economy, join us and help accelerate the growth of rare earth recycling.
 Position Overview 
 The R&D Project Manager - Solvent Extraction Metallurgy is a project-management role responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering technical R&D projects that support rare earth recycling, hydrometallurgical process development, scale-up, and commercialization. The role is expected to spend approximately 60-70% of its time on project management, project controls, stakeholder alignment, governance, risk management, and delivery of R&D milestones. The remaining 30-40% of the role provides technical expertise, such as solvent extraction and rare earth metallurgy to ensure projects are technically robust, practical, safe, and ready for scale-up or implementation.
 This position is ideal for a metallurgist or chemical/process engineer who has moved beyond purely technical execution and can lead multidisciplinary R&D workstreams with clear scope, schedule, budget, decision-making, and accountability.
 Role Focus and Time Allocation 
 Project Management and R&D Delivery: Own project planning, execution rhythm, controls, reporting, risk management, cross-functional coordination, stage-gate readiness, and delivery of agreed outcomes.
 Solvent Extraction and Metallurgical Expertise: Provide hands-on technical judgment for REE hydrometallurgy and solvent extraction test plans, data interpretation, flowsheet decisions, scale-up risks, and troubleshooting.
 Business Travel: Support project reviews, pilot campaigns, plant trials, vendor/customer engagements, strategic partner meetings, conferences, and technical troubleshooting.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Project Management 
 Project ownership: Lead multiple R&D projects from intake and scope definition through execution, reporting, stage-gate review, handover, and close-out.
 Scope, schedule, and budget: Develop project charters, work breakdown structures, schedules, budgets, resourcing plans, procurement inputs, milestone plans, and change-control processes.
 Project controls: Track schedule, cost, resources, technical progress, risks, issues, dependencies, action items, decisions, and deliverables using clear and disciplined project management tools.
 Governance and stage gates: Prepare decision packages, readiness reviews, test campaign plans, technical summaries, risk assessments, and stage-gate materials for leadership and project sponsors.
 Cross-functional leadership: Coordinate metallurgists, scientists, engineers, technicians, operations, EHS, procurement, finance, and other key stakeholders as required.
 Stakeholder communication: Provide concise project updates, executive summaries, dashboards, presentations, meeting minutes, and escalation notes that make technical and business decisions easier.
 Risk and issue management: Build and maintain risk registers, mitigation plans, issue logs, contingency plans, decision records, and lessons learned for R&D, pilot, and plant-facing activities.
 Commercialization readiness: Translate R&D outcomes into practical implementation plans, operating envelopes, design inputs, SOP requirements, commissioning inputs, and plant trial plans.
 Safety and compliance: Ensure R&D projects are planned and executed with appropriate EHS reviews, chemical hygiene controls, waste management practices, management of change, and safe work practices.
 2. Solvent Extraction and Metallurgical Expertise 
 Technical direction: Provide metallurgy input during project scoping, experimental planning, test campaign design, data review, and decision-making.
 REE solvent extraction: Guide work involving extraction, scrubbing, stripping, phase separation, impurity rejection, recycle streams, reagent systems, organic/aqueous ratios, acidity, pH, loading capacity, and product quality.
 Process performance: Optimize REE recovery, selectivity, purity, yield, throughput, reagent consumption, impurity control, phase disengagement, crud control, entrainment, and third-phase risk.
 Scale-up judgment: Identify technical risks when moving from bench to pilot, demonstration, or plant conditions, and ensure project plans include the right validation steps and decision criteria.
 Technical documentation: Ensure technical reports, flowsheet inputs, mass balances, metallurgical accounting, troubleshooting guides, and project close-out documents are accurate and actionable.

 Practical solvent extraction and hydrometallurgy knowledge, including aqueous chemistry, organic reagent systems, equilibrium behavior, circuit configuration, phase disengagement, impurity removal, and scale-up considerations.

ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

We are looking for Software Engineers to join our team. This is a specialized, high-impact role sitting at the intersection of high-performance computing (HPC) and Large Language Model (LLM) engineering. You will not just be building the automated "speedometer and diagnostic" suite for our next-generation AI infrastructure; you will be defining the roadmap, driving key technical decisions, and taking full ownership of the future of this work.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Benchmarking: Evaluate, run and automate standard LLM quality benchmarks (GSM8K, MMLU) alongside custom performance suites for specific workloads (e.g., long-context window, KV cache reuse, disaggregated serving).

 - DevEx Improvement: Develop and maintain internal GPU-enabled development environments (similar to GitHub Codespaces). You will ensure the team has seamless, high-performance "dev machines" optimized for model experimentation.

 - Tool Development: Build and contribute to open-source tools such as InferenceMAX and genai-bench to automate model evaluation, benchmarking and analysis.

 - System Profiling: Use profilers like PyTorch Profiler, NVIDIA Nsight Systems and py-spy to collect performance profiles, identify bottlenecks, and debug the compute/networking stack.

 - Monitoring & Observability: Develop real-time dashboards and alerts to monitor system health, model startup times, and runtime performance.

 - Continuous Integration: Automate performance testing via CI/CD pipelines to catch regressions and build release workflow automation for the model runtimes stack.

 - Optimization Automation: Build tools to find the "Pareto frontier"—identifying the absolute best configuration (latency vs. cost vs. quality) for a given model and workload.
   
   

REQUIREMENTS

This is a mid-senior, high leverage role. We care about your technical depth, strong communication skills to drive cross-team efforts, ability to navigate vague requirements and mentor other engineers. We want to talk to you if you have:

 - A Love for Systems & Hardware: You aren’t just interested in the AI; you want to understand GPU memory subsystems, InfiniBand, and how data moves across a cluster.

 - An Automation Mindset: You believe that if a task has to be done twice, it should be scripted. You have a passion for stress-testing and fuzzy testing to find the "breaking point" of a system.

 - Mathematical Curiosity: A desire to understand the underlying math of Transformers and how it translates into FLOPs and memory requirements.

 - Technical Toolkit: Familiarity with Python, and an eagerness to master the NVIDIA software stack. C++ familiarity is good to have.
   
   

WHY THIS ROLE

 - Direct Impact: Your tools will be the gatekeeper for what defines "good" performance for our customers.

 - Deep Learning (Literally): You will gain world-class expertise in GPU orchestration and LLM inference that few engineers in the industry possess.

 - High Ownership: As the lead of a small team, you will have the autonomy to build tools from scratch and contribute to open-source projects.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

Contexte 
 La Ville de Saint John invite les résidents intéressés à siéger au Conseil des commissaires de police de Saint John à présenter leur candidature.
 Le Conseil des commissaires de police assure une gouvernance civile et une surveillance du Service de police de Saint John, conformément à la *Loi sur la police* du Nouveau-Brunswick. Les commissaires aident à établir les priorités, les politiques et l’orientation stratégique des services policiers à Saint John, tout en veillant à ce qu’il y ait une responsabilité envers la collectivité.
 La Ville encourage les candidatures de personnes représentatives de la diversité de la communauté de Saint John. La variété des points de vue et des expériences renforce la capacité du Conseil à servir efficacement les résidents.
 Le Conseil des commissaires de police de Saint John (ci-après « la Commission ») constitue l’autorité responsable de la gouvernance du Service de police. Son rôle consiste à veiller à ce que le service policier soit adéquat, efficient et efficace, et qu’il reste, dans une mesure raisonnable, en phase avec l’évolution des besoins, des valeurs et des attentes de la collectivité. La Commission exerce une gouvernance civile objective par le biais de l'orientation stratégique, de la surveillance et de la reddition de comptes au public. Dans ce contexte, elle doit respecter l’indépendance opérationnelle légitime du chef de police en ce qui a trait aux décisions opérationnelles individuelles — par exemple, déterminer s’il convient de mener une enquête, d’intenter des poursuites ou de procéder à une arrestation, et de désigner les personnes visées par ces mesures.
 La Commission compte un nombre de commissaires nommés entre sept et huit. La province du Nouveau-Brunswick est responsable de la nomination d'un commissaire. Le maire (ou son représentant) siège au conseil, et les autres commissaires sont nommés par le conseil municipal.
 Description du poste 
 Engagement de temps :
 Les réunions ont lieu onze (11) fois par année et durent environ 3 heures. Les commissaires consacrent en outre 50 à 60 heures par année aux tâches liées au comité et doivent participer à une séance de formation annuelle d’une (1) journée.
 Le président ou la présidente doit assister, à l’occasion, aux réunions du conseil municipal ainsi qu’à des réunions se tenant à l’extérieur de la localité.
 Autorité :
 L’autorité de la Commission est déléguée exclusivement par l’entremise de règlements administratifs, de politiques et de résolutions. En aucun cas, l’autorité de la Commission ne peut être déléguée à un(e) commissaire pris(e) individuellement. Il est interdit aux commissaires, à titre individuel, de donner des directives au chef de police ou à tout autre agent de police, de discuter de questions liées aux relations de travail en dehors des réunions de la Commission, ou de s’exprimer publiquement au nom de la Commission.
 Mandat :
 3 ans; nomination par le conseil municipal.
 Rémunération :
 Actuellement en cours d’examen.
 Relève de :
 Le président ou la présidente de la Commission.
 Responsabilité (reddition de comptes) :
 La Commission rend compte au conseil municipal, conformément à son mandat, ainsi qu’au ministre de la Justice, en vertu de la *Loi sur la police* et de ses règlements d’application.
 Responsabilités :
 Le rôle de la Commission consiste à assurer et à maintenir un service de police adéquat, efficient et efficace, qui soit, dans une mesure raisonnable, en phase avec l’évolution des besoins, des valeurs et des attentes de la collectivité. La Commission exerce une gouvernance civile objective par le biais d'orientations stratégiques, d'une fonction de surveillance et d'une reddition de comptes publique. Dans ce contexte, la Commission doit respecter l’indépendance opérationnelle légitime du chef de police en ce qui a trait aux décisions opérationnelles individuelles — par exemple, décider s’il convient de mener une enquête, d’intenter des poursuites ou de procéder à une arrestation, et déterminer les personnes visées par ces mesures. Fonctions générales :
 Chaque membre de la Commission est tenu de :
 • S'efforcer d'être pleinement informé des questions stratégiques concernant les forces de l'ordre et la sécurité de la collectivité
 • Se préparer à toutes les réunions de la Commission et y assister
 • Agir en tant que membre d’une équipe, contribuer activement à l’exercice du rôle de la Commission et, par la suite, soutenir toutes les décisions prises par celle-ci
 • Examiner de manière critique les rapports soumis à la Commission, en posant des questions et en approfondissant les points qui relèvent du rôle de la Commission
 • Participer aux travaux des comités
 • Se conformer au Code de conduite
 • Participer aux discussions et au processus décisionnel concernant des politiques policières adéquates et efficaces, ainsi que les vérifications et les mesures correctives nécessaires
 • Participer à l’élaboration du plan stratégique pour les services policiers à Saint John
 • Participer à l’évaluation du rendement des forces de l’ordre par rapport au plan stratégique
 • Participer à l’évaluation annuelle du chef de police
 • Participer au processus de sélection du chef de police
 • Participer aux négociations collectives
 • Participer aux délibérations budgétaires et au suivi des activités financières
 Qualifications :
 • Connaissance de la communauté
 • Sens des processus
 • Pensée stratégique
 • Jugement éclairé
 • Capacité de travailler en équipe
 • Intégrité
 • Volonté d'apprendre
 Révocation d'un membre du conseil :
 Les commissaires peuvent être suspendus ou révoqués de la Commission en cas de violation du code de conduite ou d’absences répétées aux réunions de la Commission.
 Exigence relative à la vérification des antécédents judiciaires
 Veuillez noter que les citoyens souhaitant siéger à la Commission de police doivent consentir à une vérification de leurs antécédents judiciaires. Les candidats admissibles devront participer à une entrevue visant à évaluer dans quelle mesure les compétences acquises au cours de leur parcours professionnel peuvent être mises à profit dans le cadre des travaux de la Commission.

HTS Assist est l'assistant d'intelligence artificielle agentique de Hopper pour le voyage, qui résout de vrais enjeux clients comme les changements de vol, les annulations, les remboursements et les réservations, par clavardage et par la voix, pour certaines des plus grandes marques et entreprises de voyage au monde. La voix pose ses propres défis produit, de la latence et de l'alternance de la parole jusqu'au moment de l'escalade vers un humain, et ce poste couvre les deux volets avec la même rigueur. 

À titre de directeur ou directrice principal(e) de produit, vous serez responsable de l'agent orienté client de bout en bout : les conversations, l'interface et l'expérience que nos partenaires offrent à des millions de voyageurs. Il s'agit d'un poste délibérément axé sur le design, où vous serez la personne qui tranche les décisions de design au quotidien, en façonnant directement les parcours et les interfaces en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de design de nos partenaires et notre designer interne.


À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. 
 That is the whole job.
 Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
 So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
 You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
 Here is what "end to end" actually means.
 You are the account manager. We do not have any.  You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.  Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.  We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
 You can live anywhere.  We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 What the job looks like 
 Own a set of DTC accounts  as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
 Own the client relationship.  There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
 Audit before you touch anything.  Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
 Run brand and non brand as different businesses.  Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
 Know what PMax is actually doing.  The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
 Keep Google's automation on a leash.  Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
 Own the feed.  Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
 Own the tracking.  GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.  Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
 Build the things the account needs.  Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
 You are a fit if 
 You have done this with real money.  Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
 You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
 You are AI native, and you build.  This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
 You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.  You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
 You are skeptical of your own numbers.  You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
 You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.  Where you live is up to you.
 Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
 You are not a fit if 
 "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
 You want to be told what to do this week.
 You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
 You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
 Why this role is exciting 
 This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
 You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
 You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
 You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend. We're trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend. We're looking for a driven, systems-minded, and execution-focused GTM Campaign Manager to join us on our journey.




ABOUT THE ROLE



As a GTM Campaign Manager, you will architect and operate the campaign systems that convert pipeline strategy into pipeline reality. Working directly under GTM Engineering, you'll build, launch, and continuously optimize the campaigns and targeted lists that feed our go-to-market teams — across every source of pipeline: inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion (cross-sell/upsell).



Think of this role as a regulator's right hand. Procurify's pipeline comes from multiple, interdependent sources, and the business's #1 constraint is total pipeline coverage against our revenue targets. Rather than owning any single channel in isolation, you'll help balance effort dynamically across all of them — surging outbound when inbound softens, activating expansion campaigns against the install base, and calibrating targeting by segment so we maximize total pipeline, not just one number.



We're looking for someone who thinks from first principles — questioning why a campaign, list, or process exists, breaking it down to its fundamentals, and rebuilding it in ways that are simpler, faster, and more scalable. This is not a role for someone who runs one-off campaigns and moves on. We want a systems thinker who sees how targeting, data, messaging, and channels connect — and who designs campaign engines that compound in value over time rather than resetting from zero every quarter. The best campaign is often the one you can systematize and automate away.



This role also sits at the intersection of campaign execution and our evolution as an AI-enhanced platform. You'll champion how AI and automation can eliminate manual list-building, generate and personalize outreach at scale, surface which segments and plays are converting, and free human effort for the highest-leverage pipeline. If you see systems where others see silos, and you believe the best process is one you can automate, you'll thrive here.



We're also looking for someone relentless about the "last mile." Strategy without clean execution and closed-loop communication is worthless — the difference between a booked meeting and a lead sitting untouched. You'll own that last mile as a system: build the list, launch the campaign, hand it off cleanly, communicate it clearly, and measure what actually happened — then feed those learnings back into the engine.



This is not a systems-administration role (that's RevOps), a people-management role (that's BDR leadership), or a strategy-and-budget role (that's Demand Gen leadership). This is the connective tissue that all of those functions rely on but none of them owns: turning targeting, positioning, systems, and AI into campaigns that drive real pipeline.




WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON:




CAMPAIGN SYSTEMS ACROSS ALL PIPELINE SOURCES

 - Design and operate repeatable, scalable campaign systems — not one-offs — that generate pipeline across inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion.

 - Build and deliver targeted, ICP-aligned lead lists to BDRs proactively and on a repeatable cadence — increasingly automated and AI-generated — as the single most reliable driver of booked meetings.

 - Design, launch, and optimize outbound campaigns end-to-end for both new-business and expansion pipeline, using automation and AI to scale personalization and volume without sacrificing quality.

 - Support inbound performance by iterating and building on systems that improve MQL→SQL conversion.

 - Build expansion (cross-sell/upsell) campaign systems against the existing customer base in partnership with Customer Success and Account Management — a large, under-served pipeline source today.

 - Calibrate campaign targeting by tier/segment (SMB vs. mid-market) to protect and maximize total pipeline, not just a single tier.
   
   


PIPELINE COVERAGE & REBALANCING (UNDER GTM LEADERSHIP)

 - Help monitor pipeline coverage across all sources as a connected system, and reallocate campaign effort to the highest-leverage source as conditions shift.

 - Work from the operational math: track conversion rates by source (MQL→SAL→SQL→pipeline $), model where the leverage is, and use data and automation to drive proactive intervention through GTM led efforts.

 - Flag pipeline softness early, so the business can compensate proactively rather than discovering gaps a quarter too late.
   
   


AI, AUTOMATION & FIRST-PRINCIPLES OPTIMIZATION

 - Apply first-principles thinking to identify and remove friction in how campaigns are built, launched, and handed off — automating the repeatable and reserving human effort for high-value plays.

 - Champion AI and automation across the campaign lifecycle: list generation, enrichment, segmentation, message personalization, sequence optimization, and performance analysis.

 - Continuously deconstruct and rebuild campaign processes to be faster, simpler, and more scalable as we grow.
   
   


LAST-MILE OWNERSHIP & CLOSED-LOOP EXECUTION

 - Ensure clean, automated hand-offs to BDRs and AEs — leads loaded, listed, assigned, and communicated so nothing sits un-worked.

 - Support data fidelity across platforms (Salesforce, Marketo, sequencing, enrichment tools) as a power user of the systems RevOps builds.

 - Define and track measurable outcomes per campaign and per source (SAL, SQL, pipeline $) so "what good looks like" is always explicit — and feed learnings back into the system.
   
   


COLLABORATION & CROSS-SYSTEM ALIGNMENT

 - Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Product Marketing, Sales, BDR leadership, and Customer Success to align targeting, messaging, and campaign execution across the funnel.

 - Apply existing positioning and personas to concrete targeting — and flag when segment/positioning shifts appear to be suppressing high-converting traffic.

 - Work cleanly across teams without owning any of their core mandates — you are the systems builder and connector, not the administrator or the people manager.
   
   


KPIS FOR SUCCESS

 - Increased qualified pipeline creation across all sources (inbound, outbound, tier, expansion), measured in SQLs and pipeline $ — accelerated by AI and automation.

 - Consistent, proactive delivery of high-quality targeted lists to BDRs and AE’s — with measurable lift in meeting production.

 - Improved conversion efficiency across the funnel (session→MQL, MQL→SQL, SAL→SQL).

 - Growth in expansion/upsell pipeline generated through structured, repeatable campaign systems.

 - Reduced manual effort per campaign through automation and systematization.

 - Zero leads lost to poor hand-off — clean, closed-loop execution with no items sitting un-worked.

 - Early, accurate surfacing of pipeline-coverage risk against targets.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 1–3 years in a campaign management, demand generation, sales development, or GTM operations role (or a sharp, high-potential candidate ready to grow into it under mentorship).

 - A systems thinker who sees how people, processes, tools, and data connect — and who designs for scale rather than one-off fixes.

 - A first-principles problem solver who questions assumptions, deconstructs complex processes, and rebuilds them more efficiently.

 - Genuine enthusiasm for AI and automation — with a track record (or strong interest) in using them to eliminate manual work and amplify pipeline output.

 - ICP, persona, and tier fluency — able to independently determine who to target and why, and translate positioning into executable campaign systems.

 - Quantitatively strong — can track conversion rates and pipeline coverage across sources and understand where the leverage is (this is a math + systems + execution role, not execution alone).

 - Proactive, closed-loop communicator — flags blockers early and asks for help rather than silently stalling.

 - Comfortable rebalancing priorities as conditions change; thrives in ambiguity with strong organization.

 - Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce) and sales/marketing automation (Marketo, Outreach/sequencing, enrichment tools like ZoomInfo/Clay).

 - Strong project management, organization, and communication skills, with an impeccable eye for detail.

 - Bonus: Experience in high-growth SaaS; familiarity with Gong, Clay, ZoomInfo, AI/automation tooling, or enablement platforms.
   
   

For customer-facing or GTM roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.




WHY PROCURIFY?




HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

 

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

 

Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release here https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/. With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.

 

The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

 

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.

 


BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

 

 - Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada! And US if applicable.

 - Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

   This range is dependent on experience, with a component of these earnings made up of a Company Incentive Plan (CIP) target of 5% of base salary, and not inclusive of any benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.



 


LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

 

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. About the company 
 Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.
 Project Highlights 
 Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
 Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
 Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
 No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
 All contributors are license-verified physicians
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved
 What this project involves 
 We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:
 Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
 Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
 Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.
 Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.
 What we look for 
 This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:
 Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
 Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
 Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
 Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
 Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
 Strong written English (C1+).
 This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.
 How it works 
 Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks
 Flexibility 
 You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.
 Earnings 
 Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
 Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



We're looking for a Staff Developer to join our Authentication Enablement team. Our mission is to help people, families and businesses unlock 1Password and access their information safely and simply, with authentication that stays in the background. Every 1Password app establishes its session with our servers through the service this team owns, whether the user signs in with a password and Secret Key, SSO, a passkey, MFA or a trusted device.





As a Staff Developer, you’ll help move authentication out of the monolith and into an independent service with its own data, so sign-in can scale and stay available independently of the rest of the platform. The service continues to handle production traffic throughout the migration, so we’re moving endpoint by endpoint and table by table, with weighted rollouts, consistency checks and tested rollback procedures. You'll help set the technical direction for the migration and for new authentication services, as 1Password extends trusted access to AI agents.





How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - Significant experience building and operating backend services.

 - Deep expertise with distributed systems and data: moving live traffic or data between systems without downtime, event streaming or change data capture, and keeping two sources of truth consistent through a cutover.

 - Strong experience designing asynchronous workflows and migrating synchronous processes that depend on large atomic transactions to eventually consistent designs, while preserving correctness, clarifying tradeoffs, and improving performance.

 - Working knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth, OIDC, WebAuthn, passkeys, or MFA, including common implementation pitfalls and security risks.

 - A track record of setting technical direction for a team: owning large, multi-quarter projects, writing the designs others build from, and explaining tradeoffs to engineers and leadership alike.

 - You raise the engineers around you through reviews, design feedback and mentoring, and you work to hand off ownership rather than holding on.



Bonus points for:

 - Extensive experience with Go or another backend language such as Java, C#, Rust, C++, or Python.

 - Experience extracting services from a monolith.

 - Experience with MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and DynamoDB at scale.

 - Familiarity with Secure Remote Password protocol.

 - Owning services with strict availability targets, including SLOs, on-call and incident response.



What you can expect:

 - Lead a portion of the authentication service's roadmap for the next 12 months, and work closely with leadership to ensure that planning reflects the full scope of requirements.

 - Own significant designs in the remaining migration: moving session and device management flows, switching source of truth one provable iteration at a time, and publishing authentication events for other services to consume.

 - Make and document the team's technical decisions, weighing reliability and security against delivery.

 - Set the team's standards for testing, observability and safe rollout, so regressions surface before customers see them.

 - Build the platform pieces the service needs when 1Password doesn't have them yet, and work with sibling teams to propagate new distributed system standards across the organization.

 - Partner with the Authorization, Identity Services and Security teams, and guide the product teams whose features depend on authentication as they integrate with the service.

 - Hold AI-assisted work on security-critical code to the same bar as everything else: human judgment, careful validation and small, reviewable changes.

 - Participate in the 24/7 on-call rotation for tier-one services.



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $192,000 USD and $278,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $167,000 CAD and $242,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
